About MOCHA - Museum of Children's Art

profile.summary: The Museum of Children's Art (MOCHA) is an Oakland nonprofit founded in 1988 that offers arts education for children and families. It runs visual arts instruction in East Bay schools, workshops at public libraries, youth programs, and museum activities such as exhibitions, open studios, field trips and art camps.
